caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate object resembling a tall candlestick or ornamental pedestal, rendered in fine pencil or ink lines on a beige, lightly textured background. The object stands vertically in the center of the page and consists of a wide, round base decorated with embossed patterns and symmetric floral motifs. Rising from the base, the column is decorated with sculptural human figures in classical garb standing in a group around the lower section. The shaft above the figures narrows and features minimal geometric detailing, including a meander or Greek key pattern, and culminates in a bulbous, diamond-shaped finial at the top. The entire composition is monochromatic with no color other than the grey of the graphite or ink and the beige of the paper. Some text is faintly visible below the base, noting "SCALE 2/3 ACTUAL SIZE" and “TIFFANY G. ANDERS & CO.”
title: Parade Fire Horn
